memory_update.text: SPSC should be tracked as an underfollowed retail-supplier data/replenishment chokepoint candidate for the retail shelf access/private-label node.
UNFI should be tracked as a second-order retailer-services/private-brand infrastructure candidate, especially for independent and regional grocers lacking internal category-control scale.
SENEA should be tracked as a narrow private-label packaged-food manufacturing candidate, with key risks around customer concentration, commodity inputs, and crop/working-capital volatility.

TreeHouse Foods was a strong pure-play private-label public comp but completed a take-private transaction on February 11, 2026; remove THS from active US-listed candidate screens and use it as a private-market validation signal.

The node's likely public-market mapping is not only private-label manufacturers; it also includes retail EDI networks, planogram/category-service providers, distributor private-brand platforms, packaging suppliers, and negative-comparison national brands with high retailer dependence.

node: Retail shelf access, private-label displacement and category control
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the retail shelf access/private-label node found one obvious retailer-control reference anchor and three underfollowed public-market mappings: retail EDI/replenishment infrastructure, independent-grocer private-brand/category services, and private-label packaged-food manufacturing. The strongest underfollowed chokepoint candidate is SPS Commerce because it sits in the data/replenishment layer between retailers and suppliers. UNFI is a second-order beneficiary candidate because it packages private brands, planogram/shelf support, pricing, and retailer services for independent grocers. Seneca Foods is a narrower private-label manufacturing exposure in shelf-stable fruits and vegetables. Walmart is included only as a reference/control anchor for retailer private-label power, not as the main discovery target.
